structure: Independent persons follow a bivariate random-intercept model: each visit equals a stable component vector plus an independent visit-deviation vector. Gaussian distributions complete the generator, but all three requested Pearson correlations are identified by the supplied second moments and independence assumptions.

parameter_provenance.basis: Measurement means are zero and visit deviations have zero means, so stable-component means are zero.
Pearson correlation of stable X and Y components.
Pearson correlation of measurements at the same visit.
Each measurement has variance 5. Same-visit covariance is 0.52*5=2.6. Subtracting stable covariance 3.2 gives deviation covariance -0.6.

parameter_provenance.value: Stable component vector and different visits' deviation vectors are mutually independent; persons are independent.
parameter_provenance.basis: Uses the stipulated component/deviation and between-visit independence at the bivariate-vector level.
Convenient distributional completion; Gaussian shape is not required to identify the requested correlations.

requested_estimands.name: change_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Stable components cancel in changes. Independent visits give change variances 2 and change covariance 2*(-0.6)=-1.2; correlation is -1.2/2=-0.6.

requested_estimands.name: same_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Directly supplied by B and reproduced at both visits: (3.2-0.6)/5=0.52.

requested_estimands.name: cross_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Cov(X_visit1,Y_visit2) equals stable-component covariance 3.2 because different visits' deviations are independent and independent of components. Correlation is 3.2/5=0.64.

limitations: This is an artificial mathematical population, not a clinically validated model.
Gaussian shape is assumed; higher-order distributional features are not supplied by the records.
The records imply measurement variances of 5 despite the standardized-unit terminology; measurements are not rescaled to unit variance.
Population constraints hold in the generator's distribution. Random finite samples will not reproduce them exactly.
checks_actually_performed: Analytically verified positive definiteness: component covariance eigenvalues are 0.8 and 7.2; deviation covariance eigenvalues are 0.4 and 1.6.
Analytically verified measurement variances 5, same-visit covariance 2.6, cross-visit covariance 3.2, and change covariance -1.2.
Inspected the source for the required wide column order, unique integer identifiers, seeded randomness, and absence of sample-moment adjustment.
